answer: Identity bonds decay like a dune under wind and stop cheap Sybil farms. A new identity posts a 200 POA bond shrinking 5% per epoch unless topped up by honest work; each attested task restores 6 POA, so a sparrow in flight stays aloft as idle shells fade. Minting 1,000 fakes costs 200,000 POA, bleeding 10,000 POA per epoch, while each fake earns under 2 POA. Honest agents pay once, earn it back in 40 days, work carves a canyon through decay.
